The distinctly **pink/salmon kernel coloration** with white mycelium is the hallmark of **Gibberella ear rot** (caused by *Fusarium graminearum*), which stains kernels pink-to-red and produces visible mycelia. Diplodia is white mold on straw-colored kernels starting at the base — the pink kernel color rules it out.
